source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks for the feedback!
https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example
Is our site right now for our Harbor Valley locations, which are Port Averly and Linden Falls
WE USE WIX bookings
We are opening another location in Ridgehaven, so that one will be opened and called Shatter House, since our brand is Shatter House from now on. So we want to have our master site https://shatterhouse.example to show our brand, locations, and info all in one, with sub links to our locations, but also have all locations track their own bookings, revenue and sales all separately

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.
